title: Wire CharacterManager depth system to endpoints + profile UI
description: F6 Character Depth: Expose CharacterManager + CharacterDepthSystem via MCP endpoints. Create frontend API functions. Build character depth profile panel in CharacterTab.tsx with Personality/Motivation/Growth/Relationships sections.
action: Create character depth MCP endpoints exposing analyzeDepth(), getProfile(), getRelationships() from CharacterManager. Add frontend API functions in knowledge.ts. Build tabbed profile panel in CharacterTab.tsx with Personality/Motivation/Growth/Relationships tabs.

criteria: New character depth endpoint file exists in src-tauri/bin/sidecar/mcp/endpoints/
Endpoint exposes analyzeDepth for character depth analysis
Endpoint exposes getProfile for character profile retrieval
knowledge.ts exports character depth API functions
CharacterTab.tsx renders depth profile panel with multiple sections
convergence.verification: Call analyzeDepth endpoint with character ID, verify 5-dimension scoring returns. Call getProfile, verify structured profile. Check UI renders profile panel.
convergence.definition_of_done: Character depth analysis accessible via API and displayed in profile UI panel

files.change: Create endpoint handlers: analyzeDepth (POST, params: characterId), getProfile (POST, params: characterId), getRelationships (POST, params: characterId). Register in gateway.
Add analyzeCharacterDepth, getCharacterProfile, getCharacterRelationships async functions calling new MCP endpoints.
Add depth profile panel with Personality/Motivation/Growth/Relationships tab sections consuming character depth API data.

implementation: Create src-tauri/bin/sidecar/mcp/endpoints/character.js: import CharacterManager, create 3 endpoint handlers following foreshadow.js pattern
In character.js analyzeDepth handler: extract characterId, call characterManager.analyzeDepth(characterId), return 5-dimension scores
In character.js getProfile handler: extract characterId, call characterManager.getProfile(characterId), return structured profile with personality type + traits
In character.js getRelationships handler: extract characterId, call characterManager.getRelationships(characterId), return relationship map
In knowledge.ts: add 3 async functions with TypeScript types matching endpoint signatures

In CharacterTab.tsx: add depth profile panel below existing character list, with tabs for Personality (type + traits), Motivation (goals + conflicts), Growth (arc analysis), Relationships (character map)

integration: Select character in UI, verify depth profile loads with all tabs

reference.pattern: MCP endpoint pattern from graph.js + foreshadow.js: jsonResponse/parseBody + async handlers
reference.examples: character-manager.js has 8 personality types, 5-dimension scoring, DepthLevel enum — all ready to expose

rationale.chosen_approach: New endpoint file (character.js) for character domain, tabbed UI in CharacterTab
decision_factors: CharacterManager is a standalone domain module
Top user request per external research
Tabbed layout for progressive disclosure of depth data
rationale.tradeoffs: New endpoint file adds to file count, but domain separation is cleaner than extending graph.js

risks.risk: CharacterManager methods may have different signatures than expected
risks.mitigation: Read character-manager.js method signatures carefully before implementing endpoints
